title: Hunger Is a Fact
description: Lestat's first lesson is deliberately unromantic: vampirism has a blood economy whether the Overlord finds that poetic or tedious. Refill that reserve through one of NightWalker's real blood-bottle paths, then return to him.
description_completed: The Overlord has deliberately fed the NightWalker blood reserve after transformation. Hunger is now an understood operating condition rather than an unexplained penalty.

dialogue.offer: The hunger is not a philosophy, mon Overlord. It is a fact. Ignore it and your body will explain the matter less elegantly. Feed the reserve on purpose once. Then we can discuss power without pretending appetite is beneath you.
dialogue.in_progress: Still resisting the lesson because it is simple? Hunger is wonderfully indifferent to dignity.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: There. Better to feed because you chose to than because desperation chose for you.
dialogue.completed: Remember the distinction. Appetite is not shameful. Being ruled by an appetite you refuse to understand is merely sloppy.

prerequisites.name: Receive Lestat at the Dark Tower
Remain within the NightWalker vampire path

objectives.name: Drink blood through a real NightWalker blood-bottle path
Drink a Player Vampire Blood Bottle
